name: Plugin Manager
author: Vestra Player
punchline: See the installed plugins; disable, enable or uninstall them
description: Lists every plugin of the player on the Plugins page of the options window: version, source, state and data size. Select a plugin to see its details (failure reason, source, package folder, data folder, capabilities), disable or enable it, reload it, uninstall it (optionally with its settings and data), or open its data folder. Built-in plugins, installed with the player, cannot be uninstalled.
